top_signals.title: Trump plans to cut Canadian goods from government buyers
top_signals.summary: The move deepens the two countries' trade war and threatens to roil a system meant to smooth the sale of commercial goods to agencies across the U.S.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ex-US Trade Representative: US-Canada Ties Remain Vital
top_signals.summary: Former US Trade Representative Susan Schwab says shared geography and deep economic ties will keep the U.S. and Canada aligned despite upcoming political friction. She notes that joint cooperation on critical minerals and a unified front against Chinese competition are essential to protect North American industry. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Microsoft adds age-awareness APIs that can tell if users are children, teens, or adults
top_signals.summary: Microsoft is adding new age-awareness APIs to Windows 11 that will allow apps to determine whether someone is a child, teenager, or adult without exposing their exact date of birth. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: JR East unveils new character options to succeed the Suica penguin
top_signals.summary: A brown squirrel, a purple rabbit or an orange creature carrying a bag with a mole in it will replace East Japan Railway Co.'s Suica penguin.
